master.prompt: Cobalt blue all-terrain 6x6 cargo truck, 8.6m long, exactly THREE evenly spaced axles with identical fully visible 1.51m mud-terrain tires, deep chunky lugs. Expedition box with ladders and roof lights. Thick dried mud. Calm believable grey elephant standing in tall open-top wooden crate strapped to deck; head and ears above crate, generous top margin. No cartoon face. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Premium semi-realistic painted game illustration matching Swamp Scout: dark readable contours, weathered materials, fine mechanical detail, rich natural texture, soft even daylight. Facing right. True transparent background, no halo, ground, shadow, text, logos or watermark. Full object with generous clear margins. PNG at least 1500px long side. Flat orthographic side elevation: no front face of cab, exactly 3 round equal tires with centered rims, same horizontal hub line. Horizontal deck. Landscape canvas at least 2000px wide. Elephant ears and head clear of all edges. CRITICAL axle placement: exactly three wheel hub centers at 20%, 50%, 80% of vehicle length. The middle axle must be directly under the expedition box; equal wheelbase between first-middle and middle-last. No rear tandem cluster. Include 5% clear margins on ALL sides.

body.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit mire-king-6's own vehicle-master-v1.png; canvas EXACTLY 1774x887 pixels. Remove ALL THREE road tires/rims: three road wheels below truck, one rear, one middle, one front. Preserve the elephant, wooden crate, blue expedition box and cab. Remove all road rubber tires and rims COMPLETELY. Paint OPAQUE wheel-well interiors across the ENTIRE UPPER HALF of each original tire circle from fender lip to ORIGINAL HUB LINE, full arch width: dark solid metal inner fender liners with chassis rails, small axle housings, leaf or coil springs, shocks, air lines and mud flaps in the same weathered painted style. NO transparent holes above hub line. Fill gaps between tandem arches down to original hub line too. Background must not show when separate tire drops a third radius. Below hub line leave lower half of each removed tire circle transparent; preserve transparent open ground clearance under chassis. No tire tread, rims, discs, full black wheel circles, ghosts or far tires. Change NOTHING ELSE: all load, cab, equipment, spare and non-wheel-region pixels untouched. Exact same canvas size, position, scale, camera, clear margins. strictly flat 2D side profile, camera perpendicular to the near side at hub height, no perspective, all tires the same size on one level line, no far-side tires. Premium semi-realistic painted game illustration, readable dark contours, weathered materials and fine mechanical detail, soft even light. True alpha transparent background, no checkerboard, halo, ground, shadow, added text or watermark. Return ONLY the edited PNG at the exact original dimensions.

local_processing.authorization: User explicitly approved local PNG alignment and preservation of master pixels.
